hints.text: You're in a safe camp. [WASD] move, [{sprint}] run, [{toggle_camera}] camera.
Talk to the trader [{interact}] to buy and sell. The banker keeps your stuff safe when you die.
Outside the walls zombies can see and hear you. Gunshots are loud.
Melee is quiet. [{slot_1}] bat, [Left click] swing.
Search crates and buildings for loot [{interact}].
Eat and drink from the hotbar [{slot_3}]/[{slot_4}] or the backpack [{inventory}].
Night is coming. Runners hunt at night: stay near the camp or use the flashlight [{slot_6}].
You lost your bag and cash, but kept your skills and the bank.
Heavy bag. Sell or bank loot at the camp.
4 wood make a campfire kit (backpack → Craft).
A dog breeder sells puppies [{interact}]. The dog follows you and fights. {dog_stay}: stay. If it dies, it is gone for good.
Bounties pay dollars and XP. Take up to 2 at a time from the board [{interact}].
You're getting cold. A campfire, warm clothes or shelter will help.
The heat makes you thirsty. Drink water and cover your head.
Roads lead out to the far lands. The farther you go, the more dangerous it gets.
Towns have good loot but many zombies. Watch your back.
